settings.exportDescription: saves your exercises, templates, training days and workout history to a file. Use it as a backup or to move your data to another device. Workouts in progress are excluded.
settings.importDescription: replaces the selected data with data from the file. Workouts in progress will be removed.
settings.clearDescription: deletes your completed workout history. Your exercises, templates, training days and workouts in progress are kept.

backup.title: Backup
backup.introTitle: Keep a copy of your workouts
backup.purpose: Use “Import data” to restore your data after reinstalling Liftika or to transfer it to another device.
backup.contents: The backup includes completed workouts with weights and reps, training days, templates, and your exercise library with any changes you made.
backup.instructions: Choose a folder for your backup file, such as Documents or Downloads.
backup.updates: Liftika automatically updates this file when you make changes to your workout log, training days, templates, or exercise library.
backup.chooseFailed: Couldn’t access the selected file. Try choosing another location.
backup.writeFailed: Couldn’t update the backup. Try again or choose another location.
backup.statusFailed: Couldn’t check the backup. Restart the app or choose a backup location.

prep.reselectWorkout: Go back to Home and select a workout again.

active.restart: Go back to Home and start the workout again.

plan.trainingDaysIntro: Set up the workouts shown on your Home screen.
plan.trainingDaysLimit: Each workout can target up to two muscle groups.
plan.exerciseLibraryUse: Use these exercises in templates, in Custom Workout, and when replacing exercises.
plan.exerciseTemplatesIntro: A template is a preset list of exercises for a muscle group. You can create several templates and pick one before starting a workout.
plan.exerciseLibraryIntro: Manage the exercises available for each muscle group. Each exercise can include step-by-step instructions and a link to a video or GIF.

exercises.name: Exercise name
exercises.renameDescription: Renaming keeps this exercise’s weight and rep history. For a different movement, create a new exercise.

technique.gifError: Couldn’t load the GIF. Check the link.
technique.linkHelp: How to add a video or GIF link
technique.youtubeHelp: Open the video or Short on YouTube, tap Share, then copy the link.
technique.invalidLink: Check the video or GIF link.
technique.title: Exercise technique
technique.defaultVideoNote: This exercise comes with a public YouTube video. You can replace it with another video link in the exercise settings.
technique.gifHelp: For a GIF, press and hold the image in your browser, select Copy image address, then paste the link here.

journal.adjustFilter: Try selecting different muscle groups or exercises.
journal.reselectWorkout: Go back to the log and select the workout again.

import.title: What would you like to import?
import.description: The selected data will be replaced with data from the file. Workouts in progress will be removed.
